_doc: LIST-INGEST-1110 (SEED-SCI-1110 S10 and CHUNK-VALUE-1110 H.8): the search-free list-ingest route, POST /ingest/list (X-API-Key). Read by vera/list_ingest.py. Every identifier goes through the existing acquisition gates (Europe PMC OA resolve, licence, injection, content/relevance, robots/rates); no web search of any kind is made. Origin is forced to seed (low priority behind visitor jobs, seed share of the acquisition queue caps).
_caps_note: Planner priors, uncalibrated. These count items accepted into the queue by this route; the shared auto_acquire jobs_per_hour / jobs_per_day / queue_max caps and BG_MIN_FREE_HOURLY_JOBS apply on top (one job per item).
_reserve_note: F1: a list item is queued only while at least this many places of auto_acquire's queue_max stay free for visitor jobs. max_arxiv_lookups_per_call bounds INSPIRE/OpenAlex identifier lookups per call (F2). ingest_key_env: the dedicated key (env var NAME only) for /ingest/list and its outcomes; unset = the route is disabled.
